Warfarin + Ciprofloxacin.effect: Ciprofloxacin inhibits Warfarin metabolism → increased anticoagulation → bleeding risk
Warfarin + Ciprofloxacin.recommendation: Avoid combination or monitor INR closely every 2-3 days
Warfarin + Ciprofloxacin.alternative: Use Nitrofurantoin or Fosfomycin for UTI instead

Warfarin + Aspirin.effect: Dual antiplatelet + anticoagulation → severe bleeding risk
Warfarin + Aspirin.recommendation: Only use if absolute indication (e.g., mechanical heart valve + ACS)

Metformin + Contrast Dye.effect: Risk of contrast-induced nephropathy → lactic acidosis
Metformin + Contrast Dye.recommendation: Hold Metformin 48h before and after contrast studies

eGFR_30_50.Digoxin: Reduce to 0.125mg daily or every other day
